description: Wrapper-only minimization of the title-tie geometry ordering candidate. The backend payloads are renamed to one-character files and the subprocess bootstrap is reduced while keeping clean output.

build.packaging: Minified title-tie geometry-order Python wrapper with one-character payload files.

basis: Same decoded backend, same cmix-compressed dictionary, and same title-tie geometry ordering key as the parent package; only wrapper source and asset filenames changed.
deps: C++ runtime for the bundled cmix/fx2 binary

10m_inherited_from_parent.roundtrip_basis: Backend payload, dictionary payload, and ordered stream match the verified title-tie parent package.

verdict: Promote after current-driver smoke. Inherited evidence makes this the best exact 10MB package score currently known in this repo, but it has no exact 100MB gate yet.
